title: 第15章 墨家集会第16章 小富婆曹茱萸
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
碍于宋南烛那两条修长而且实力极强的美腿，沈无名最终还是屈服了。
不仅给她贡献了一大堆的冰糖葫芦，甚至还签下了一堆不平等条约。
答应帮她做一些别的零食……
甚至靠着零食外交，沈无名在整个侯府都打通了关系。
从楚平山的下酒菜，到苏月娥的美容汤。
还有自家娘子喜欢的酸甜零嘴，以及太平公主、供奉客卿、家丁护院、丫鬟仆人……
现在提到沈无名，侯府上下无不竖起一根大拇指。
连带着他的食家修为都提升了不少。
不过除了这两个小插曲，沈无名的生活又恢复了平静。
除了偶尔让丫鬟们去做点零食之外，就是继续看书。
随着科举的时间越来越近，楚幼仪也将更多的时间花在了他的身上。
教了他不少的东西，同样，双方的关系在飞速进展。
甚至到了晚上，楚幼仪都会固定时间带些宵夜过来，然后跟他讨论经史子集。
今天的零食是酸枣糕，楚幼仪是真的喜欢酸甜口。
沈无名吃了两块酸枣糕，又喝了一碗银耳莲子羹，然后说起诗词歌赋。
“当代诗赋句式追求骈偶，声律谐协，文辞藻饰，但很多华而不实。”
“反倒是春秋战国，虽然也有一定程度的铺陈，可还是更为实际。”
沈无名忍不住吐槽道。
这不仅仅是诗词歌赋的变化，甚至还涉及到诗词用出来之后的威力。
“若非如此，儒道修士也不会讲究古韵，动不动就是四书五经，而不会推崇当代。”

包括沈无名自己的修行，都是以诗经为主，而不是后面的各种经典。
“夫君还真是聪慧，哪怕失去记忆之后，也能很快察觉到这一点。”楚幼仪笑着道。
“其实当代儒林中人，已经有不少人都在说，要法古，要追求实际。”
“这一帮人被称为古派，讲究发言真率，无所畏避！”
“不过如今骈文大行其道，拥趸仍然不少，这一批人就是今派。”
沈无名若有所思，不出意料的话这就是唐宋古文运动，没想到这个时代还真有。
“那古派是哪些人？”沈无名问道，他虽然看了很多史书，但也没见具体划分。
“当代领袖是韩昌黎，不过前人梁宽、独孤志等人就有所提及。”
“他们每一位都是当世最顶尖的大儒，不仅在方面造诣深厚，而且实力极强。”
“所以他们发声，不管朝廷还是民间，都有极大回应……”
两人又探讨着古派和今派，不知不觉，已至夜深。
“那我先回去了。”看了一眼窗外，已经月上柳梢头，楚幼仪才恋恋不舍离去。
“我送你。”
沈无名已经习惯了两人之间的相处，随她一同出门，走向隔壁的房间。
其实不过七八步之遥，但每天晚上都是沈无名陪他走过去的。
“好。”
楚幼仪温婉一笑，随即伸出了自己纤细白洁的小手，让沈无名都愣了一下。
随即哑然失笑，他牵起楚幼仪的小手，只觉滑腻柔软，朝着外面走去。
送到楚幼仪的门口，沈无名才松开手，“突然有些遗憾，你的房间这么近。”
楚幼仪脸颊发红，微微低首，没有回头，只是闷声不想走进房间，然后关上门。
content_en:
Due to Song Nanzhu's two slender and extremely powerful legs, Shen Wuming finally gave in.
Not only did he contribute a lot of candied haws to her, but he even signed a bunch of unequal treaties.
Promised to help her make some other snacks...
Shen Wuming even relied on snack diplomacy to establish connections in the entire Hou Mansion.
From Chu Pingshan’s snacks to go with Su Yue’e’s beauty soup.
There are also sweet and sour snacks that my wife likes, as well as Princess Taiping, enshrined guests, servants and guardians, maids and servants...
Now when Shen Wuming is mentioned, everyone in the Hou family gives a thumbs up.
Even his gourmet cultivation level has improved a lot.
But apart from these two episodes, Shen Wuming's life returned to peace.
Apart from occasionally asking the maids to make some snacks, I just continued to read.
As the imperial examination time drew closer, Chu Youyi also spent more time on him.
Taught him a lot of things, and the relationship between the two parties is progressing rapidly.
Even in the evening, Chu Youyi would bring some late-night snacks over at a fixed time, and then discuss the Classics and History Collection with him.
Today’s snack is jujube cake. Chu Youyi really likes sweet and sour taste.
Shen Wuming ate two pieces of jujube cake, drank a bowl of white fungus and lotus seed soup, and then talked about poems and songs.
"Contemporary poetry pursues parallelism, harmonious rhythm and diction, but many of them are flashy and unrealistic."
"On the contrary, it is the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. Although it has a certain degree of elaboration, it is still more practical."
Shen Wuming couldn't help but complain.
This is not only a change in poems and songs, but also involves the power of poems after they are used.
"If this were not the case, Confucian and Taoist monks would not pay attention to ancient rhymes, and would always read the Four Books and Five Classics, instead of advocating contemporary ones."
Including Shen Wuming's own practice, he mainly focuses on the Book of Songs, rather than the various classics that follow.
"My husband is really smart. Even after losing his memory, he can quickly notice this." Chu Youyi said with a smile.
"In fact, many contemporary scholars are already saying that we must follow the ancients and pursue reality."
"This group of people is called the Ancient Sect. They pay attention to speaking truthfully and forthrightly, and they are not afraid to avoid anything!"
"However, parallel prose is now very popular and there are still many fans. This group of people is the Jin sect."
Shen Wuming was thoughtful. As expected, this was the ancient prose movement of the Tang and Song Dynasties. He didn't expect it to actually exist in this era.
"Who are the ancient sect?" Shen Wuming asked. Although he had read many history books, he could not find any specific divisions.
"The contemporary leader is Han Changli, but his predecessors Liang Kuan, Dugu Zhi and others have mentioned him."
"Each of them is one of the top scholars in the world. Not only are they profoundly accomplished in various fields, but they are also extremely powerful."
"So when they spoke out, there was a huge response from both the court and the people..."
The two discussed the ancient and modern schools again, and before they knew it, it was late at night.
"Then I'll go back first." Chu Youyi reluctantly left after taking a look outside the window and seeing the moon above the willow trees.
"I'll give it to you."
Shen Wuming had become accustomed to the two of them getting along with each other, so he went out with her and walked to the next room.
In fact, it was only seven or eight steps away, but Shen Wuming walked there with him every night.
"Okay."
Chu Youyi smiled gently, and then stretched out her slender and white hands, which made Shen Wuming stunned for a moment.
Then he burst into laughter. He took Chu Youyi's little hand, which felt smooth and soft, and walked outside.
After arriving at Chu Youyi's door, Shen Wuming let go of his hand, "Suddenly I felt a little regretful that your room is so close."
Chu Youyi's cheeks turned red and she lowered her head slightly. She didn't look back. She just muttered that she didn't want to walk into the room and closed the door.
